prompt: Create a soft, naturalistic lifestyle portrait of a young East Asian woman in her twenties spending a lazy weekend morning in a cozy vintage bedroom. She stands centered in a doorway or closet nook, facing the camera with a calm, slightly playful sleepy expression, clear eyes, subtle makeup, and realistic skin texture. Her long black hair loosely tied in a low ponytail with wispy strands falling around her face should look casual and slightly messy. She wears a loose plain white short-sleeve V-neck T-shirt and blue-black gingham plaid loose pajama pants. Her arms are raised above her head, holding a large cream-colored pillow horizontally like a soft cushion resting over the top of her head. Use warm diffused morning light from the left, with a sheer white curtain occupying the left edge of the frame and creating a hazy, gentle glow. The room is small and homey with dark wooden trim, off-white walls, hanging clothes in the background including a dark striped sweater, a crocheted vest, and denim fabric, plus a dark suitcase or storage box near the floor. Add delicate white hand-drawn doodles overlaying the photo: exactly 13 visible doodle elements consisting of the handwritten words morning chaos, four small stars near the text and upper right, two tiny hearts, one small bunny-like scribble, one crescent moon, one dashed curved trail on the left, one dashed curved trail on the right, and two small sparkle marks. Style the image as an intimate candid film photograph with soft focus, mild grain, pastel warmth, vertical 4:5 composition, no harsh contrast, no glamour retouching, no extra people, no watermark, and no additional readable text beyond the doodle phrase.

promptZh: 创作一张柔和、自然的生活方式肖像，画面中一位 二十多岁的东亚年轻女性 正在舒适的复古卧室中度过慵懒的周末早晨。她站在门口或衣橱角落的中心位置，面向镜头，表情平静且带有一丝俏皮的睡意，双眼清澈，妆容淡雅，皮肤纹理真实。她的 黑色长发随意扎成低马尾，几缕碎发散落在脸颊旁 看起来随意且略显凌乱。她穿着一件宽松的纯白色短袖 V 领 T 恤和 蓝黑色格纹宽松睡裤。她双手举过头顶，横向抱着一个大大的奶油色枕头，就像一个柔软的靠垫放在头顶上方。使用来自左侧温暖的漫射晨光，画面左边缘有半透明的白色窗帘，营造出朦胧柔和的光晕。房间小巧温馨，带有深色木质装饰，墙面呈灰白色，背景中挂着衣服，包括一件深色条纹毛衣、一件钩针编织背心和牛仔布料，地板附近还有一个深色的行李箱或储物盒。在照片上添加精致的白色手绘涂鸦：共 13 个可见的涂鸦元素，包括手写文字 morning chaos、文字附近及右上角的四颗小星星、两个小爱心、一个像小兔子一样的涂鸦、一个月牙、左侧一条虚线弧形轨迹、右侧一条虚线弧形轨迹以及两个小闪光标记。图像风格为亲密自然的胶片摄影，具有柔焦、轻微颗粒感、柔和的暖色调，采用 4:5 竖构图，无强烈对比，无精修美颜，无额外人物，无水印，且除涂鸦短语外无其他可读文字。
